shared_elements: schematic representation of a living form (figures in A, apparent creature outlines in B)
justification: The only correspondence is at the most generic level: both surfaces carry a roughly circular motif and outlined, schematic depictions of living forms rendered in line. Otherwise they share nothing: A is a densely organised composition with a rayed disc above symmetrical standing human figures over many ruled registers of dense sign-writing, whereas B shows a few large, bold, isolated curvilinear relief forms with no registers, no text-like signs, no human figures and no ordered composition.
